_doc: Task phrases that put an open necklace's run line first in a recommendation answer (agent_market/concierge/necklace_lead.py, PM 11-16 08:2x plan C, for the first open necklace on 11-17). Lower-case, matched as whole words in the task. A necklace that is not offered (necklace_surface.offered) is never shown, whatever is listed here. Keep phrases specific to what the necklace answers; a wrong lead costs the caller a wasted call. 11-16 08:5x (PM: false leads first): company-due-diligence answers US SEC filers only, so its phrases name SEC, EDGAR or 10-K/10-Q filings and never 'company profile', 'due diligence' or a bare '10-k' (a race distance).
